outputs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Magenheim Rootforged modular construction concept sheet revision 3.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target kit sheet; Image 2 is the user's authoritative reference for monumental pillar foundations, metal embellishment and carved/runic surface language. Do not copy the people or scene.
Primary request: Keep the parchment landscape kit board and its entwined-root beams, pillars, forked columns, braces and symmetrical modular arches. Correct ONLY the stone foundations/plinths and floor walking surface, including their detail views and assembled bay.
Foundation: replace the boring rough rubble slab with massive dressed dark-grey Understone block foundations and tall substantial square pillar pedestals inspired by the bottom of the hall pillars in Image 2. Broad heavy stone faces, stepped foot and cap, elaborate recessed interlace relief and runic panels, dark forged metal borders, corner straps and rivets. Carved motifs use strong readable bands, not tiny clutter. Stone is the main mass, metal embellishes it. Clearly show a substantial monumental entwined WOOD root column rising directly from the broad stone pedestal, with a fitted metal collar. Update the pillar plinth close-up and assembled bay accordingly. Keep both a broad 2x2 foundation module and matching raised embellished column plinth visible in the foundation panel; small height labels may be removed rather than conflict.
Floor: change the aggressive open tangled root lattice on TOP into a quiet flat fitted rootwood walking deck with broad close-fitting worn surfaces, subtle grain and restrained root seams. No large roots snaking across the walking surface, no holes or trip hazards. Preserve visibly entwined thick roots in perimeter frame and underside support logs. Underside logs reach adjacent tile seams. Make stairs similarly walkable. Update assembled bay floor.
Constraints: Rootforged remains entwined-root construction, not ordinary straight lumber pillars or a stone-only kit. Keep existing member families, iron bands, modular endpoints and both arch feet aligned. Reference 2 determines foundation embellishment, not hall scale; drawn dimensions remain illustrative. Maintain useful neutral inspection lighting, no glow, no new figures, no unrelated props. Retain professional painted game-production concept style and full sheet layout.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image is a Rootforged modular kit concept sheet. Change ONLY the 4m FLOOR TOP VIEW and its FLOOR TOP DETAIL inset and visible walking surface in the assembled bay. All other pixels/design families, embellished stone bases, braided root columns, arches, stairs, labels, board layout remain unchanged. The FLOOR TOP must be a FLAT QUIET CLOSE-FITTED WOODEN WALKING DECK. Replace all winding raised surface roots in its central walking area with six to eight broad flattened fitted rootwood boards/slabs running in parallel. They have subtle irregular worn grain and quiet shallow seams, no crisscrossing strands, no rope braids on top, no exposed protrusions, no root spaghetti. Braided roots remain ONLY around the outer perimeter frame and in the underside supports shown next to the top view; underside root support view stays unchanged. Floor top detail inset must show an unmistakably flat closely fitted walking face, not twisting surface tendrils. The wooden building structure still remains ENTWINED ROOTS; only the floor walking face becomes flat fitted rootwood. Neutral parchment board style. Preserve the highly embellished runic/interlace Understone plinths with metal borders.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the horizontal WORLROOT BEAMS 2m/4m/8m in the top-left panel and corresponding horizontal top beam in assembled bay on this Rootforged board. They currently look like open railings. Make each a continuous DENSE SOLID load-bearing fused-root timber mass with a chunky broadly rectangular cross section: root strands tightly grow into a thick wood core, no light can show through, no long open gaps, no spaced horizontal rails, no lattice, no fence. Retain entwined ROOT identity through a few deep curving grain ridges fused into its surface and thick root contours, not ropes wrapped around ordinary lumber. Dense wood volume at ends, clean aligned modular endpoints. Remove little stone support feet from horizontal standalone beam views; these are beams, not railing sections standing on posts. Keep iron collars binding beam ends. Depict real structural scale. Preserve all other existing details: flat fitted floor top and current root underside supports, ornate metal-bordered runic Understone foundations and pillar plinths, braided vertical root pillars and braces, symmetric arches, stairs, detail studies, parchment layout, palette and labels. Do not replace root pillars with the separate massive timber posts. Only change beam mass/readability; no other redesign.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Magenheim Valheim mod monumental Worldroot timber pillar ADDITION concept sheet, separate from the established entwined-root modular kit.
Input images: Image 1 user's hall reference defines massive wooden posts atop embellished stone bases. Image 2 existing Rootforged sheet defines compatible dark iron, grey Understone, worn wood palette and presentation; do not duplicate its braided root columns.
Primary request: Create one focused landscape parchment production study titled 'MONUMENTAL WORLDROOT POSTS'. Show a separate family of massive solid grown-wood posts, broad square or subtly octagonal trunks, on huge Understone foundation blocks. They must read as the enormous wooden hall pillars in Image 1, not thin lumber, braided root bundles, or stone columns. Main pair of 4m and 8m post modules over matching 2x2m pedestal footprint, proposed scale marks only, one small human silhouette. Warm dark reddish-brown timber, deep continuous grain, worn hand-carved Nordic relief panels in the lower timber face, restrained metal bands and strong fitted metal socket at base. Pillar bases are heavy dressed grey stone blocks with stepped feet and caps, dark riveted metal border/corner embellishments, broad recessed interlace and runic relief surfaces inspired by the hall. Stone main mass; metal frames it. Clearly show stone-to-wood seam. Include front and side silhouette, socket cutaway, one relief closeup and a simple two-post supporting-beam assembly. Modular tops and bottoms have deliberate aligned load-bearing endpoints. Root lineage appears as timber grain and small restrained root ridges, NOT intertwined braided columns. Preserve the separate entwined-root set rather than redraw it here. Do not show a floor redesign. Strong low-poly game silhouette, coarse painted textures for carving and grain, practical readable restrained surface density, imperfection/wear, neutral lighting, no glow, no people or feast from source, no decorative random cubes, no new gameplay claims. This is concept guidance, not a runtime geometry delivery.
